title: Strictly convex Pfaff-Darboux representations adapted to a positive Legendrian foliation for a torsion-free affine connection
author: Robert L. Bryant
work: On the Convex Pfaff-Darboux Theorem of Ekeland and Nirenberg
source_version: Official SIGMA 19 (2023) article 060, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2023.060; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof upgrades positivity only along the prescribed Legendrian leaves to strict positivity of every coordinate Hessian on the ambient tangent space. It successively changes the Pfaff coordinates by quadratic corrections, a one-variable convex reparametrization and controlled positive linear mixtures. The final perturbation makes all coefficient functions positive while preserving the given foliation and the exact one-form representation, an additional construction beyond the ordinary Pfaff-Darboux normal form.

source_check.note: The complete Theorem3.3 constructive proof is included. M is a smooth manifold with a torsion-free affine connection, omega has fixed Pfaff rank k-1 through omega wedge (domega)^k=0 and omega wedge (domega)^(k-1) nowhere zero, and the given omega-Legendrian foliation has leafwise positive-definite symmetric covariant derivative S^nabla omega. The result is local at every point, with strictly nabla-convex functions constant on the prescribed leaves and positive smooth coefficients. The classical Pfaff-Darboux theorem is explicitly prior background; the author actually gives all of the new convexity and positivity adjustments. The unadapted corollary and Euclidean special case are not additional counted units.
